capabilities: Scan all vault files for internal links with no matching note, heading, or block
Browse broken links in a folder, file, or link-name view with counts and sorting
Open the note containing a broken link by clicking it
Create the missing note or edit the source note via built-in commands and context menus
extras: README notes that plugins which restyle the core file explorer can break the plugin's layout, and provides a CSS snippet in the resources folder as a workaround.
problem: Internal links that don't connect to any file are scattered across a vault, and there is no built-in view that collects and counts them all, including broken heading and block references.
summary: Link checker that scans the vault for internal links pointing to missing notes, headings, or blocks and lists results in folder, file, or link views.
